title: Compute-Constrained Safety Filters with Neuromorphic Event Triggering
summary: Safety filters that rely on control barrier function (CBF) quadratic programs (QPs) are typically analyzed under the assumption that the QP is solved instantaneously, although nonzero computation time can render a computed input unsafe by the time it is applied. This paper develops a dual leaky integrate-and-fire (LIF) event-triggered safety filter for linear systems that accounts for this delay.
